description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting Standard for Smaller Entities - 2015
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the adoption and publication of the Sri Lanka Accounting Standard for Smaller Entities 2015 (SLFRS for Smaller Entities 2015) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It establishes a new regulatory framework and compliance requirements for financial reporting by smaller entities, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) concerning regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
